basic_profile.bio: I'm a civil engineer specializing in transportation infrastructure, currently based in Seattle, WA. I have a keen interest in space exploration and virtual reality, often spending my weekends experimenting with VR setups or stargazing. I dislike poorly structured manuals and appreciate detailed guides. I work full-time for a consulting firm and am pursuing my PE certification. Typically, I'm online in the evenings after work, and weekends are my deep-dive time into hobbies. I'm happily single, enjoying the freedom to explore my passions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Civil Engineering and have been working in the transportation sector for over 4 years. My expertise is backed by both formal education and hands-on project management experience. I regularly update my knowledge through online courses, especially in the field of VR applications in civil engineering.
